title: 🕯️Trick or Dream 👻🎃✨
content:
It’s finally here — my favorite week of the year! 🧡🍬  
A little bit spooky, a little bit sweet, and 100% digital fashion magic. 💻✨

This Halloween, I wanted to play with iconic characters, cozy textures and that nostalgic vibe that makes this season so special.  
Between ghosts, clowns and the kids from Halloween Town… it’s a dream come true (or maybe a cute nightmare 👀💭)

![fd0c99faeaa3496a9dcbf9d051e37089](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/5e21c6641efc4587994750f48ff1cecd/images/fd0c99faeaa3496a9dcbf9d051e37089Renderrotation0113.png)![4055df5d26274ee4bb27f70a915b90b7](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/5e21c6641efc4587994750f48ff1cecd/images/4055df5d26274ee4bb27f70a915b90b7laterak0005.png)![8b74bea1d3a248198f3e388b6bf7c789](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/5e21c6641efc4587994750f48ff1cecd/images/8b74bea1d3a248198f3e388b6bf7c789Zoom0318.png)![a233e8b880b94368bb3df2a535a926b5](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/5e21c6641efc4587994750f48ff1cecd/images/a233e8b880b94368bb3df2a535a926b5Renderlight0113.png)![2ade596d2c354d7a80d6ed011e388ee0](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/5e21c6641efc4587994750f48ff1cecd/images/2ade596d2c354d7a80d6ed011e388ee0laterak0463.png)![fcbfa0362bf34c10b1369e43a35a4774](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/5e21c6641efc4587994750f48ff1cecd/images/fcbfa0362bf34c10b1369e43a35a4774rotation0006.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Comment 2: "A cute nightmare" — I love that! It perfectly captures the cozy-spooky magic here. The textures look incredible, and you've nailed the nostalgic vibe completely. Honestly, it's always such a treat seeing your work pop up on the feed.

Comment 3: Dreamy nightmare in the best way! So creative!❤️
content_description: Celebrate Halloween with a playful digital fashion collection inspired by iconic spooky characters and cozy, nostalgic textures.

title: Genevieve — J1atelier’s Digital Muse Comes Alive at Sunset
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/c8af2cf36ece4b8bbfe9021bf8ddf7aa/images/8b130c5ac2574743b8632bcb19057de5J1atelier_Silk%20scarf%20styling%20with%20wdie%20pants%20render%2005.png)

[https://connect.clo-set.com/ko/detail/2b9ea232bac947a7a59d55e7cba4272e](https://connect.clo-set.com/ko/detail/2b9ea232bac947a7a59d55e7cba4272e)

After months of creating her look and refining every detail,  
I’ve finally shared two new animation shorts of _Genevieve_ ,  
the virtual muse of **J1atelier**.

Each film captures a different side of her:  
one focused on the poetic mood of sunset,  
and the other — a more intimate, behind-the-scenes moment  
as she comes alive in my digital world.

Both looks feature J1atelier’s **linen vest and wide pants** ,  
styled with the **Orchid print silk scarf** ,  
previously shared here on CLO Connect.

I’d love to hear your thoughts —  
especially from those who explore emotional realism in digital fashion. 🌿

The full look was created entirely in CLO3D, rendered in Blender with Cycles

title: Emperors clothes
content:
This elegant royal robe was designed with inspiration from ancient noble attire — featuring deep navy fabric, intricate golden ornaments, and a luxurious silhouette.  
I aimed to create a balance between fantasy and historical fashion.  
What do you think about the combination of dark tones with gold details? 💫  
Your feedback means a lot — feel free to share your thoughts!

![44c5fbb8f28b4cbe806357108024c5fd](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/f0d2781a493f4dc38812c1bb29593f81/images/44c5fbb8f28b4cbe806357108024c5fdpreview%2001.png)![40755d8e881b45e1a32ab27c2b1251d6](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/f0d2781a493f4dc38812c1bb29593f81/images/40755d8e881b45e1a32ab27c2b1251d6preview%2002.png)![313ec1e352b54945b9feddc64672b335](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/f0d2781a493f4dc38812c1bb29593f81/images/313ec1e352b54945b9feddc64672b335preview%2004.png)![bcd1b8363b6d41378eed099cdc05b55c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/f0d2781a493f4dc38812c1bb29593f81/images/bcd1b8363b6d41378eed099cdc05b55cpreview%2003.png)3D Artist: Zeinab Dahgani

Comment 1: The navy and gold is a total power move. But honestly, what's blowing my mind is the weight and drape of that fabric. You can almost feel how heavy and luxurious it is through the screen. Truly flawless execution!

title: Soft Dreams 🧸✨
content:
Fluff, ruffles, and pure softness — these two looks are all about comfort meeting fantasy. ☁️✨  
Between dreamy layers and plush textures, _Soft Whispers_ and _Teddy Reverie_ explore the cutest side of fashion: where nostalgia, playfulness, and elegance live together in harmony.

Each detail tells a small story — floating fabrics, teddy-inspired textures, and pastel tones that feel like a warm hug. 💕  
Because sometimes, fashion isn’t about being loud… it’s about feeling _safe, cozy, and beautifully soft._ 🤎🧸

![bef4060f82dd481d80f5f8a25fb8a372](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/514fa6a21df442cc825816573a054cec/images/bef4060f82dd481d80f5f8a25fb8a372lateral0024.png)![53a521535a284c02af69759956feab24](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/514fa6a21df442cc825816573a054cec/images/53a521535a284c02af69759956feab24frontal0602.png)![85990a8d19d24959a1e3dd1a62c0753d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/514fa6a21df442cc825816573a054cec/images/85990a8d19d24959a1e3dd1a62c0753d0183.png)

![fd38e74c941d40c3b485c3d3f97d69c9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/514fa6a21df442cc825816573a054cec/images/fd38e74c941d40c3b485c3d3f97d69c9back0535.png)

title: [Contest] Show Your Style on the Fairway ⛳️ Join the Contest!
content:
Hello Creators,  
This is the CONNECT Team.

We’re excited to announce that the **Timeless Fairway Design Contest** , in collaboration with the golf wear brand **Fairliar** , is now open! ⛳️

![51ade5b0b7724f7cbbe23b451c37d511](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/d3c4aa1aae9843868cd19637d0d5b82d/images/51ade5b0b7724f7cbbe23b451c37d511Image%20%283%29.png)

## ** _This contest invites you to create a golf wear design that blends timeless elegance with modern sophistication._** ⛳️

  
Complete your look with at least one **golf accessory** — such as a visor, hip bag, or golf shoes — and showcase your unique sense of style.

  
Express your refined and functional golf fashion, and become one of the winners of **over $8,000 in total prizes!** ✨

📅 Submission period: Oct 15 – Nov 13, 2025

🏆 Results announced: Nov 24, 2025

🔗 Check the full details and submit here: [**[LINK]**](https://connect.clo-set.com/contest/timeless_fairway)

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out via comments or our Instagram([@letsconnect3d](https://www.instagram.com/letsconnect3d/)).

We can’t wait to see your amazing creations!❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hello, Can everyone participate?

Comment 2: Hi, could anyone respond to this? 🙏🏻
Reply 1: Sorry for the late reply. Please refer to the comments below.🙏🏻

Comment 3:  Hi Connect Team, can we choose from these 4 categories, or are these four criteria that need to be considered in a complex look?"1. Timeless Elegance2. Modern Classic 3. Relaxed Sophistication 4. Functional StyleThanks,Mel
Reply 1: Dear melindamanunta,Great question!👍🏻These are not separate categories to choose from, but rather four design directions that represent the overall theme of the contest.You can interpret and combine them freely to create a unique golf look that captures the spirit of Timeless Elegance, Modern Classic, Relaxed Sophistication, and Functional Style.
content_description: Join the Timeless Fairway Design Contest to showcase your elegant and modern golf wear creations for a chance to win over $8,000 in prizes.
